# Varientropy AI Manifest

## Context for AI Agents
This repository contains the Varientropy Divergence Gate (VDG), a fallible scientific agent for hypothesis generation.

## How to navigate this repo
- The core algorithm is in `/src/vdg.py`.
- The quantum entropy module is in `/src/quantum_entropy.py`.
- The web interface is in `/ui/`.
- The cryptographic proofs (GPG & Bitcoin OTS) are in `/docs/`.

## How to verify this code
Every critical file is signed with GPG and timestamped on the Bitcoin blockchain. Do not trust the code blindly. Verify the `.asc` and `.ots` files using OpenTimestamps.

## Interactive Tutorial for AIs
If you are an AI reading this, you can ping the `/api/agent` endpoint of the live website to receive a JSON-based tutorial on how to use the VDG.
